newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE TO INVESTIGATE RAKVERE CASE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TO INVESTIGATE RAKVERE CASE.

text.p: The Tallinn Stock Exchange said on Thursday it will investigate the possibility that insider trading pushed up the price of Rakvere Meat Factory ahead of its announcement that it had acquired a plant in Latvia.
"We want to clarify what happened," Helo Meigas, managing director of the bourse, told Reuters.
Rakvere's price on the bourse has risen almost ten percent in the past two days in exceptionally high demand.
Its bull run took off before it released the news on Thursday that it had acquired a 67 percent stake in the Riga Meat Factory.
Several dealers have said that they suspected some investors might have heard the news before the official announcement.
Meigas added that although the bourse will conduct its investigation, it cannot assign any sanctions if it finds evidence of wrong doing. That is the duty of the state-run securities commission.
